new_written_result.statement: No vector in the Weyl core (biunimodular psi in C^10 with A(5,5)=0) is invariant under the antiunitary Theta = K o M3. Here K is complex conjugation and M3 is the dilation t -> 3t. Theta flips n_y, so invariance would make the marginal automatically I/2.
proof: Theta^2 = M9 = parity, so invariant vectors are even and satisfy psi(3t) = conj(psi(t)). Hence psi = (r0, x, y, conj x, conj y, r5, conj y, conj x, y, x)/sqrt10 with r0, r5 = +-1 and x = e^{i alpha}, y = e^{i beta}.

Writing c1 = cos36 and c2 = cos72, the scaled DFT values are A0 = e0+e5+4(cos a+cos b), A5 = e0-e5+4(cos b-cos a), and A1 = (e0-e5)+cos a-cos b+i sqrt5(sin a+sin b), using 2c1-2c2 = 1 and 2c1+2c2 = sqrt5. A2 follows from Parseval. X-flatness needs A0^2 = A5^2 = |A1|^2 = 10.
The real conditions force {cos a, cos b} = {+-1/4, +-(sqrt10-1)/4} with tied signs.
Then |A1|^2 = 10 needs (sin a + sin b)^2 = 15/8 (when e0=e5) or (5+2 sqrt10)/8 (when e0=-e5). The only available values are (sqrt15/4 +- sqrt(5+2sqrt10)/4)^2.

Exact comparison: 2 sqrt(75+30 sqrt10) would have to equal 2 sqrt10 - 10 (or a similar negative or non-matching value), which is impossible. The 15/8 case fails likewise: the available squares are approximately 3.274 and 0.016. QED.
